interface.title: Primer Design Tool (Streamlit)
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment planning: designing and ordering oligonucleotide primers before a PCR experiment
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a DNA template (pasted, uploaded, or fetched from NCBI) into ranked Primer3 primer pairs for a chosen amplicon size range, with Tm, GC, binding positions, hairpin and dimer checks, and an order-ready CSV.

data.note: I uploaded the three test FASTA files: sample_template.fasta (472 bp, valid), sample_with_ambiguous_base.fasta and sample_too_short.fasta (80 bp). I also pasted a 321-nt test sequence that I wrote myself, three ways: as FASTA with a lowercase header, as GenBank-style numbered lines, and as a version containing R and Y. On sample_template.fasta every pair showed 'Analysis unavailable' and an empty Tm difference ('None'), and no secondary-structure table appeared. Each pair also carried a warning that its binding sites are not unique (3 or 6 possible products). The hairpin and dimer tables only appeared for my own pasted sequence. I did not press 'Fetch sequence from NCBI', because this environment has no network access.

features.name: Sequence input with source switch and validation
features.general: Pick where an input sequence comes from (file, pasted text, or remote database), clean it, and get a plain error if it can't be used
features.specific: Radio 'Paste or upload a sequence' / 'Fetch a sequence from NCBI'; file uploader (FASTA/FA/FNA/TXT) or paste box; headers, case, digits and spaces are stripped; GenBank text that keeps 'ORIGIN' and '//' is rejected; non-ACGT bases, empty input, too-short templates and NCBI mode with nothing fetched give 'Primer design failed: …' messages
steps: choose the sequence source radio
upload a FASTA file or paste FASTA or numbered GenBank sequence lines (an uploaded file overrides pasted text)
press Design primers
read the template length, or the validation error naming the bad characters or the length conflict

Paste a sequence as plain or FASTA text
Read why an input was rejected, so it can be corrected before designing
Check that the same template given in two formats yields the same design (stand-in for the pasted-versus-database-fetched agreement check)

features.name: Remote region fetch form (accession, interval, strand)
features.general: Specify a sub-region of a record in a public database by ID, start/stop and strand, and retrieve it as the working input
features.specific: NCBI nucleotide accession, contact email (help tooltip), 'Retrieve a defined sequence interval' checkbox, Start/Stop coordinates, Sequence strand dropdown (Forward / Reverse-complement), 'Fetch sequence from NCBI'; pressing Enter in a field submits the fetch. The retrieved record and anything after it were never reached (no network)
steps: enter an accession and contact email
tick the interval box and set start/stop coordinates
choose forward or reverse-complement strand
press Fetch sequence from NCBI, then Design primers
serves_tasks: Set up retrieval of a region from a public sequence database

features.name: Design constraints form with range validation
features.general: Set a numeric target range and a result count, check they are consistent, and re-run the design
features.specific: Product settings: Minimum/Maximum product size (bp) spinners (step 10) and Number of primer pairs; rejects min ≥ max and max > template length
steps: type or step the minimum and maximum product size
set the number of primer pairs
press Design primers
read the success count or the range error
serves_tasks: Generate candidate pairs with the default size range
Change the target amplicon size and the number of candidates, then re-run

features.name: Ranked candidate table (on Streamlit's built-in dataframe toolbar)

The columns are this app's; sorting by header click and the Show/hide columns, Download as CSV, Search and Fullscreen toolbar are built into Streamlit's dataframe, not designed by this app
steps: scroll across the metrics
click a column header to sort ascending, then descending
search for a primer sequence and step through the matches
hide an unneeded column
open the table full screen
serves_tasks: Compare candidates side by side in a ranked table

features.name: Per-candidate detail card with secondary-structure risk table
features.general: Expand one ranked candidate to see its key metrics, positions, quality flags and a risk table, and copy its identifiers
features.specific: 'Primer pair N — X bp' expander: copyable Forward/Reverse 5'→3' code block, Expected product, Forward/Reverse Tm metrics, GC, length, binding positions, Primer3 pair penalty, Tm difference, Recommendation, Secondary-structure analysis table (hairpin/homodimer/heterodimer: Predicted, Tm, ΔG), and a warning box (non-unique binding sites, or 'No current design warnings'). When the analysis step fails because binding sites are not unique (every pair of sample_template.fasta), the structure table, Tm difference and recommendation are missing ('Analysis unavailable') and only the warning box shows

compare forward vs reverse Tm, GC and binding positions
read the hairpin/homodimer/heterodimer predictions with Tm and ΔG (absent if analysis failed)
read the warning box
copy the pair's sequences to the clipboard
serves_tasks: Inspect one candidate's balance and binding locations
Check each candidate for self-folding and primer–primer binding risk
Copy one pair's sequences to paste elsewhere
